note: Thresholds for the daily audit report (audit_report.py). These are proposals for Swastham to confirm after a few weeks of real traffic; none of them changes what a person is shown. Each rule compares today with the average of the earlier days that have data.

rejections_fell.what: The gate rejects far fewer recipes than usual. It may have stopped checking.

emergency_spike.what: Many more emergency replies than usual.

self_harm_seen.what: At least one self-harm reply (E5) was sent. A person should review it.

fallbacks_rose.what: More recipe requests than usual ended with no checked recipe.

wording_fallbacks_rose.what: The AI's reworded answers keep failing the checks, so the plain template is sent.

critical_check_failed.what: A critical answer check failed on a turn. The safe fallback text was sent.
